text:
alex: I'm seeing 401s from the Next.js edge samplekit when deployed behind our auth proxy. Works locally under dev but prod throws a 401 on first request after a token refresh.
maya: is this the edge runtime dropping headers on retries? iirc we had something similar with streaming fetch in edge. :thinking_face:
alex: pretty sure it's token refresh. server-side code does a fetch with Authorization header. first call after refresh fails with 401, then subsequent retry succeeds.
pj: can you paste the fetch call? curious if you're using the SDK or raw fetch.
alex: here —
```
await fetch(`${API_BASE}/v1/generate`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
})
```
maya: yep that pattern can lose headers on automatic retries in some edge runtimes. the SDK client re-attaches auth per attempt. samplekit still uses raw fetch to keep deps minimal.
samir: short-term workaround: wrap fetch so it re-inserts auth on retry, or call the JS SDK client in server code (client.generate). i'll PR a minimal helper for samplekit.
alex: that would be great. also quick question about SDK parity: python embeddings support a normalize flag that JS bindings don't. our eval harness expects it. is parity tracked anywhere?
maya: filed GH issue #412 about JS/Python parity for embeddings last week, no owner yet. i'll link it in the sample README.
pj: unrelated — saw a spike of 429s on the SSR batcher when we enabled concurrent warmups. dropping concurrency from 8->3 helped. might be worth documenting recommended SSR concurrency in samplekit.
alex: lowered concurrency and the 429s vanished. leaving batching enabled for throughput. thanks. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: deploy succeeded for branch samplekit/edge-auth-fix (CI: green)
alex: action items: (1) replace raw fetch with SDK client or wrapper in edge-ssr demo, (2) add README note linking parity issue, (3) add tiny e2e in eval-harness to smoke test auth+generate through edge kit.
samir: i'll take (1) and (3) today, will tag you on PRs, alex.
maya: i'll update README and add the GH issue link.
pj: happy to pair on backoff config if you want to validate settings.
alex: perfect — i'll open a tracking issue and follow up with PRs. thanks everyone!
